title: Position Fix
note: Yuki's interior of the first ~3-5 minutes. The rain comes with her; the cold is in the cloth. She fixes the floor before she looks up — chamber estimate 18m × 12m; keystone-aligned slabs; brass nail-line warmer than adjacent stone. Cole asks before he touches; she nods. Lay on Hands restores 1 hp + mitigates cold AT MARGIN ONLY. Wet fabric remains active hazard. Her first word in this world is 'Thank you.'

origin.universe: Contemporary Earth — a rain-soaked survey expedition

litRPG_surface: Yuki's OOC blocks render as :::gridbox (spatial fix), :::exposure (cold-load active hazard tracker), :::statbox (sheet + instrument inventory), :::action (verb-target-cost-return), :::systemvoice (⟦ ⟧ engine returns).

events.note: Yuki counts seven steps as geometry, not yet a path traveled. The convergence with Mnehmos's descent (which uses literal seven steps) is geometric, not premonitory.

events.observation: One brass nail-line reads warmer than surrounding floor
events.note: Convergence with Bohdan and Cole's reads of the brass.

events.returned: HUMAN SURVEYOR · L1 · HP 8/8 · AC 11 · STR 10 DEX 13 CON 11 INT 16 WIS 14 CHA 11 · Inventory: instrument case, field notes, pencil, measuring tools, boots, rain-dark outer layer (wet)
COLD-LOAD ACTIVE · WET FABRIC HAZARD · ESTIMATED CORE-DROP RATE 0.4°C / 15min IF UNADDRESSED
events.note: Engine refused to call it slow. Yuki noted: 'Slow enough to ignore for one minute. Not slow enough to forget for five.'

events.spoken: I'm not touching you unless you say yes.
events.yuki_reaction: Saw the meaning before the phonetics resolved. Did not feel rushed. Nodded.

events.engine_return: 1 HP restored; cold-load mitigated AT MARGIN; wet fabric REMAINS active hazard
events.yuki_observed_effect: Cold withdrew from the wrist, then the seam where water was sitting, then stopped. Not a flood. Not a cure. A margin.

events.note: Her first word in this world. Quiet. Consent record kept: he asked, she consented, the System kept both facts.
